positions.title: DevOps Engineer (via WeVision)
positions.description:
● Maintained CI/CD pipelines using GitHub/Jenkins, automating deployment workflows.
● Supported an internal job scheduling system that executes thousands of data processing jobs.
● Designed and maintained a monitoring system for hundreds of EC2 instances in Python.
● Maintain observability and metrics across EC2 instances with Datadog
● Managed hundreds of Databricks jobs, reducing costs by optimizing resources.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Android
positions.description:
● Developed and maintained features for a telehealth application with thousands of users.
● Implemented a Bluetooth/BLE system to retrieve vitals data from medical devices.
● Built an application in Java/Kotlin to scan and register approved medical devices into a database.
● Utilized Azure Speech API to build transcription/translation functions for physician dictation.
● Built and maintained a data validation pipeline for YAML/JSON configuration files stored in S3.
● Implemented software requirements as test cases to ensure correct behavior and accuracy.
● Oversaw multiple releases used by thousands of real users at local clinics and hospitals.

positions.title: IT Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
●Deployed SafetyNet, a remote patient monitoring system, during the COVID-19 pandemic.
●Assisted with setup and troubleshooting of pulse oximeters, providing remote vital monitoring
for hundreds of hospitals and thousands of at-home patients across the country.

projects.title: Simple Flashlight
projects.description:
Built a small flashlight using tubular container.

Designed and soldered a simple circuit using LED's, resistors, and a button, powered by a small 12V battery.

All components were fit and attached inside the container, with the button placed in an accessible location.
